title: DelegateEval: Evaluating Platforms for Personal External Service Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.07508v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI agents that work for an individual over time may also help that individual serve external clients. We define a personal external service agent as an agent authorized and continuously managed by a specific individual to accept client requests, deliver work, and provide ongoing support using that person's knowledge, experience, professional methods, and service boundaries. Such agents could allow individuals to serve more clients with less direct involvement and generate economic value at scale. We propose DelegateEval, a platform-level evaluation framework for agent systems that may combine large language models, reusable skills, protocols such as MCP, and executable tool environments. It covers eight dimensions: ease of creation, service discovery and matching, delivery quality, expertise inheritance, service continuity, learning and improvement, reliability and governance, and efficiency and value. translated_title: DelegateEval：面向个人外部服务代理的平台评估框架
translated_abstract: 长期为个人工作的AI代理也可以帮助该个人服务外部客户。我们将“个人外部服务代理”定义为：由特定个人授权并持续管理的代理，它接受客户请求、交付工作成果，并利用该个人的知识、经验、专业方法和服务边界提供持续支持。此类代理可以让个人以更少的直接参与服务更多客户，并大规模地创造经济价值。我们提出DelegateEval，这是一个面向代理系统的平台级评估框架，适用于可能结合大语言模型、可复用技能、MCP等协议以及可执行工具环境的代理系统。该框架涵盖八个维度：创建便捷性、服务发现与匹配、交付质量、专业知识继承、服务持续性、学习与改进、可靠性与治理，以及效率与价值。这些维度用于评估一个平台能否……（原文截断）
tldr: 提出了DelegateEval——一个用于评估个人外部服务代理平台的首个平台级评估框架，从创建便捷性到效率与价值共八大维度系统衡量个人能否借助代理大规模服务外部客户并创造经济价值。
